subject: Math
text_verbatim: Chapter 1 Numberland Adventures: Up to 999 circle out of the cardboard to serve as the base for the clock. • Use toothpicks to make the Roman numbers and glue them on the cardboard. • Use markers to draw two clock hands on the cardboard. • Then decorate. Skill Sharpener 1. Circle the correct Roman numeral for the number 11: a. XI b. IX c. XII 2. Write the following numbers in Roman numerals: a. 3 = ___ b. 7 = ___ c. 10 = ___ d. 12 = ___ 3. Bunty wrote the Roman numeral VII on the board. What number did she write? 4. Babloo has X candies. How many candies does he have? 5. Bunty and Babloo played a game where they had to write numbers. Bunty wrote 8, and Babloo wrote VIII. Did they write the same number? (Yes/No) 6. In a book, the chapter number is written as IV. Which chapter number is it? 7. Ammi baked IX pies for a family gathering. How many pies did she bake? 27
